【退休難以預計？滙豐保險有✨「無後顧」之計！】

點樣先至叫真正「無後顧之憂」嘅退休生活？🤔梗係唔止係坐喺度飲茶咁簡單！ 滙豐《生活質素報告2025》顯示，港人最愛嘅微退休旅行地點分別係中國內地（37%）、日本（23%）同台灣（22%）！香港人出晒名鍾意旅遊，連退咗休都想無憂無慮四圍去，滙豐保險「滙越保險計劃」嘅「無後顧」之計就幫到你 － 提供海外支援及緊急服務*，無論你係solo trip定想同屋企人去旅行，都可以排除後顧之憂！驚退休後身體需要人照顧？你仲可以享有免費居家護理服務*🩺，全面照顧你生活所需！💪 即睇退休有咩計或與保險顧問預約會面：https://grp.hsbc/HSBCBIIPYTproductEmassTC 想知更多微退休計劃：https://grp.hsbc/60067meBY #滙豐保險 #HSBCLife #滙越保險計劃 #退休難以預計 #滙豐保險早有妙計 #退休5策萬全計 #無後顧之計 *詳情請參閱增值服務單張與其條款及細則。退休專屬增值服務由獨立第三方服務供應商提供。滙豐保險並非服務供應商或其代理人。如有任何爭議，本公司將保留最終決定權。如需了解詳情，請聯絡服務供應商。 滙越保險計劃是一款具儲蓄成分及非保證回報的長期分紅壽險產品。保費的一部分用於支付保險及相關費用。本計劃並不等同於或類似任何形式的銀行存款、年金或延期年金。保單持有人不能透過本計劃獲享稅務扣除。有關詳細產品特點及詳細的條款及細則，請參閱相關產品的保單條款。 本資訊旨在提供予香港特別行政區境內人士。 由滙豐人壽保險（國際）有限公司（註冊成立於百慕達之有限責任公司）刊發。 【Can’t see past retirement? Enjoy future assurance with HSBC Life✨】 What does a truly 'worry-free' retirement look like? It’s definitely more than just sitting around and sipping tea! HSBC Quality of Life Report 2025 shows that Hongkongers’ favourite spots for mini-retirement trips are Mainland China (37%), Japan (23%) and Taiwan (22%). Hongkongers are known for their love of travel even after retirement. And that’s why HSBC Bright Income Insurance Plan’s future assurance is essential — Whether you’re going on a solo trip or a family adventure, worldwide support and emergency service* can give you ample peace of mind! Ever thought of the need for personal care? You can also enjoy free home care service*🩺to ensure all your needs are taken care of!💪 Learn how you can better plan your retirement life or make an appointment with our insurance specialist: https://grp.hsbc/HSBCBIIPYTproductEmassEN Learn more about mini-retirement: https://grp.hsbc/60017me8x #HSBCLife #HSBCBrightIncome #PlanYourRetirement #5in1RetirementPlan *For details, please refer to in the Value-added Service flyer and the Terms and Conditions. Retirement value-added services are provided by independent third-party service providers ("Service Providers"). In the event of dispute, HSBC Life reserves the right of final decision. For details, please contact the relevant Service Provider. HSBC Bright Income Insurance Plan is a long-term participating life insurance plan with a savings element and non-guaranteed returns. Part of the premium pays for the insurance and related costs. It is not equivalent or similar to any kind of bank deposit, annuity insurance products or qualifying deferred annuity policies. This product will not provide any tax deduction benefit to the policyholder. Please refer to the policy provisions for detailed information on features, terms and conditions. The information is intended for persons in HKSAR only. Issued by HSBC Life (International) Limited (Incorporated in Bermuda with limited liability).
